svg.title: Mackity — desk input stage
svg.desc: Original illustration of a compact sixteen-channel mixing desk seen from above: a blank panel with the channel numbers along its edge, colour-banded knob columns (gain, aux sends, EQ, pan), mute buttons and long faders on every strip, a master section with a stereo LED meter. Channel 5's gain (TRIM) is turned up, its strip highlighted, and the meter reaches the clip. An illustration, not a photograph, a product drawing or an Octatrack screenshot.
